tweets: Price Oracle manipulation refers to the exploitation of vulnerabilities in price oracles.
This can lead to unauthorized actions by malicious actors.
It may cause loss of funds or data within the contract's logic.
Use decentralized oracles and leverage multiple sources for price data.
Ensure all oracle data is properly validated before use in contracts.
